summary.text: Casey O'Connor-Manasia, a Republican and Conservative Party candidate, lost the November 3, 2026 election for New York State Assembly District 61 to incumbent Charles Fall, according to unofficial results from the NYC Board of Elections and Wikipedia.
O'Connor-Manasia was on the November 3, 2026 general-election ballot after the Republican primary scheduled for June 23, 2026 was canceled.
